prose.subject: URGENT: Update to NEAR Payout Account for INV-55115
prose.body:
Hi Ines,

Hope you’re having a good week.

I’m reaching out with a quick update regarding our vendor settlement details. As of this morning, we migrated our treasury operations to a new smart contract to streamline on-chain reconciliation and reduce latency for USDC transfers.

This means our receiving address has changed for all pending invoices. Please update your payment portal to use the following new NEAR account for all future disbursements:

va1ebrookcloud29.testnet

This is critical for invoice INV-55115 (3500.67 USDC), which is currently sitting in our approval queue. To avoid a reconciliation delay that could push our next quarterly review, could you please authorize the transfer to the new address by end of day today? I’ve attached the updated bank details sheet for your records, though the on-chain address is the only change.

If you have any questions, just reply here or give me a quick call. I appreciate your help in keeping this process smooth.

Best,

Priya Moreau
Head of Financial Operations
Valebrook Cloud
valebrook-cloud.example
